settings.title: JWSoft Tiptap Editor settings
settings.description: Configure editor, upload, media, and link card behavior.
settings.legacy_warning: Legacy CKEditor inline styles, custom classes, and HTML structures are not migrated automatically. Activate only after acknowledging the transition risk.
settings.media_privacy_notice: Immediate external player loading contacts the provider when the page renders. Click-to-load is recommended for privacy.

toolbar.label: Toolbar profile
toolbar.hint: Choose the tool set for the editor.

editor_height.label: Editor height (px)
editor_height.hint: Set a value from 200 to 2000 pixels.

image_upload.label: Image upload
image_upload.hint: Allow server image uploads from the editor.

drag_drop_image_upload.label: Drag-and-drop upload
drag_drop_image_upload.hint: Upload and insert images at the dropped position.

paste_image_upload.label: Clipboard image upload
paste_image_upload.hint: Upload pasted images to the server.

uploads.title: Editor uploads
uploads.description: Review uploaded files and their current reference state.
uploads.reference_notice: Reference state is evaluated against registered content. Verify unused files before deletion.
uploads.incomplete_notice: Inactive modules may make the reference scan incomplete. Automatic cleanup stops safely.
uploads.scan_limited_notice: Reference filters inspect the latest {{count}} uploads.
uploads.delete_confirm: This deletes the file and record and cannot be undone.

upload.invalid: Only JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, and AVIF images are allowed.
upload.too_large: Images must be {{max}} MB or smaller.
upload.rejected: The image did not pass the upload policy.

media.part_rejected: The MP4 chunk did not pass the upload policy.
media.rejected: The MP4 did not pass the upload policy.

preview.rejected: The link preview could not be fetched safely.

uploads.delete_failed: The record was preserved because file deletion failed.
